device.systemGles: GLES: Qualcomm, Adreno (TM) 830, OpenGL ES 3.2 V@0800.64.8

revision.verified: The actual older export and #387 main match on engine packages, JS bundler, runtime scene/project modules and export entry points. Current packages/runtime-sdk match #388 main. Profile AAR identity is fixed across the measured branches.

oracle.pixelStatus: Independent ideal opaque texel layout, compare to physical GLES readback; compare all physical captures against base even if 8-bit render-target quantization differs.

method.scene: Twenty-seven solid quads and fifty-four opaque image quads on two procedural 16 × 16 pages. All 81 quads move each logical tick. Relative command identities were checked on the exact exported JS using a separate offline observer.
method.verification: An independent formula produced all 210 packets and the expected Java big-endian container, in slot order, with a SHA-256 trailer. The sample has 99 distinct packet bodies excluding frame IDs; all 16,929 adjacent same-slot quad records change.
method.quantiles: Nearest-rank p95 per 180-sample run (frame IDs 30–209). Pair by profile/cohort/block; do not pool raw frames or match clocks across processes. Paired differences are current minus base. Positive timing differences indicate higher cost.
method.intervals: Generation times the entire project frame invocation on the V8 worker. Copy is the VM result conversion. Dispatch to enqueue includes both plus native queueing; enqueue to callback measures the remaining host round trip. Submitted interval is not a GPU or presentation duration.
method.probe: Only probe packages read the Javet monotonic clock immediately after capture and immediately after the original EGR2 encoder returns. Encode intervals include one effective timer crossing. The 64 empty consecutive clock intervals per process are recorded both during startup and after the end. No overhead has been subtracted. Release packages contain the unaltered game export. Probe and release are independent cohorts.
commands: Export the three fixtureFiles at the base/current revision using runtime-sdk/android/player/create-app.mjs --layout embedded and the same profile AAR, esbuild 0.28.2, Node 26.7.0. Build an arm64 debug APK with the original Rust GLES3 host.

In a cold process start org.egret.example.LibraryActivity with egret.benchmark=live and egret.timing=true. Read the Activity dump after frameId 209. Separately capture egret.benchmark=capture and run-as sha256sum files/egret-project-replay.egrp; compare with oracle.tape.
method.hardware: Fold7 Android 17, V8 15.7.112.19. AARs and renderer identity frozen within each profile.

reproduction.layout: Create one directory for this record, fixture inputs under game/, and one create-app output per lane under <lane>/app. Keep the three generated project files byte-for-byte as shown in fixtureFiles. Store the scripts below alongside game/. Both scripts are independent of the collection machine.
checks: Run node oracle.mjs against the four unmodified exports. It reconstructs all commands, the complete tape, the ideal opaque image, and checks immutable command identities.

For the four additional probe lanes, run node instrument.mjs <lane> on a freshly exported app before Gradle assembleDebug. The probe expects exactly one match in the targeted revision and writes through the example Activity dump. Use <lane> from the artifacts table.

screenshotAgainstIdeal.interpretation: All differences are confined to one 22 by 195 rectangle at the right edge of the physical screenshot. Its source was not isolated. Retain all pixels for cross-build and EGL-restore comparisons.

rule.field: Probe-only per-launch encoder p95, nearest rank of 180 exact encoding samples; for each VM compare six independent old/current pairs
rule.repeatRule: Current slower than before on at least 5/6 pairs; median paired relative p95 slowdown >=5%; median paired absolute difference exceeds measured typical identical instrumentation clock cost. Failure to meet is inconclusive rather than equivalence.
rule.probeCost: For each launch combine pre+post 64 back-to-back samples each, median. Typical cost is median of the 12 per-launch medians within that VM.
rule.release: Independent uninstrumented pairs for generation, dispatch, submit interval. Never infer whole-frame or device GPU regression from the encode-only criterion.
